project_type: Electron desktop app with Lit web components (renderer), no build step
language: JavaScript (ES modules in renderer, CommonJS in main process)
build_system: Electron Forge - no bundler, plain JS loaded via script tags. nodeIntegration: true, contextIsolation: false
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to verify dependencies. 2. Validate main process modules load: node -e require('./src/storage'). 3. Check new store/service files parse without errors. 4. Verify no syntax errors in Lit components by checking they parse as valid ES modules.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install new npm packages, cannot use @lit/context or signals. Must use bundled lit-core-2.7.4.min.js. No build step - files loaded directly. Renderer uses ES modules (import/export), main process uses CommonJS (require/module.exports).
contribution_requirements: Run npx prettier --write . before committing (4-space indent, single quotes, semicolons, 150 print width). No TypeScript currently despite AGENTS.md aspirations - this is plain JS.
key_patterns: Renderer components import Lit from '../../assets/lit-core-2.7.4.min.js'. Views extend LitElement with static styles and properties. Main process uses CommonJS require(). IPC bridge: renderer calls cheatingDaddy.storage.* (defined in renderer.js), main handles via ipcMain.handle('storage:*'). Storage reads/writes JSON files synchronously via readJsonFile/writeJsonFile helpers. The typing/ system is well-architected with separate concerns (BackendManager, TypingManager, etc).
directory_structure: src/index.js - main process entry. src/index.html - renderer HTML. src/storage.js - sync JSON persistence. src/utils/ - main process utilities (window, gemini, renderer, etc). src/components/ - Lit web components (app/, views/). src/typing/ - modular typing system. src/assets/ - bundled libs (lit-core, marked, highlight). src/preload.js - preload script.
